title: Calendar: today opens Today, past days open the day modal, future days do not respond
context: The design lets only days with sample data respond, which is an artefact of its sample data. The live calendar opens the day modal for every day, today and future days included.
options: Past days and today respond, future days dimmed (recommended)
outcome: Past days and today, chosen by the owner. Today's cell opens the Today page, any past day opens the day modal, an empty past day offers "Add a note", and future days are dimmed and inert.
